changes.to: Arabic: keyed by skeleton (consonants + long vowels A/U/I) so short vowels can be typed or left out; Arabic costs 20 more than its frequency so the other languages keep first places until Arabic leads; loose matches (doubled consonant taken once) get no own place in the bar; pack 1.8 MB with 20 000 words (approved estimate was about 1 MB: going lower lost common words); while typing, digits 2, 3, 5–9 join the word when an Arabic word goes on that way instead of choosing the candidate of that number (1 and 4 still choose), and a digit starts a word only when an Arabic word starts with it; numbers stay numbers; candidate kind tagged ع; the bar now keeps the cheapest kinds when more than nine match.
